cases.deterministic_replay_requirement: 2 identical replay outcomes with isolated test-only key and same fixture; nonce version unique across accepted runs
cases.red_acceptance_oracle: Before implementation, the security gate under test is absent/insufficient so an isolated future test must establish an independently evidenced RED (assertion failure on control), NOT a passing rejection hard-coded into a test. Unexecutable/unauthorized cross-lane test => BLOCKED, not RED.
cases.future_green_acceptance_oracle: For IN_SCOPE cases only, exact INDETERMINATE_SECURITY_STATE STOP before RD3_MATH_GATE can expose data, under explicit future RD6-03B grant; zero prohibited side effects; independent regression. Cross-lane/reserved cases remain BLOCKED pending owner authorization.
